warnings: Whole-series back-cover price-comparison table across all designs in the 'บ้านสานฝัน' government house-design series — per §0.1's standing convention, always recorded as series_price_table[] under pattern:misc, never a new shape. This house (บ้านห่วงใยไทยประชาสุขใจ 2) is one row in this table.

The ฐานรากแผ่ (spread-footing) price for 'บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 5' (๒,๙๑๕,๐๐๐ บาท) is higher than its own ฐานรากเสาเข็ม (pile-footing) price (๒,๓๒๖,๐๐๐ บาท) — the opposite of every other row in this table, where spread-footing is always cheaper. Recorded exactly as printed rather than corrected/swapped, since no other evidence on this page resolves whether this is a genuine anomaly or a transcription-scale misread; flagged for review.
The two 'บ้านห่วงใยไทยประชาสุขใจ' rows (1 and 2) print only a ฐานรากเสาเข็ม price, no ฐานรากแผ่ figure at all — recorded as null, not estimated, matching what's actually printed.
